## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## How was it checked?

List the focused checks and whether `npm run check` passed. Explain any checks
you could not run. Distinguish fixture validation from live-provider verification.

## Review notes

Note public API changes, relevant limitations, and official provider references
for changed contracts. Use synthetic examples; omit secrets, private responses,
personal paths, and local audit reports.
